mapper.select: UPDATE workflow_instance SET status = 'RUNNING', updated_at = now() WHERE instance_id IN ( SELECT instance_id FROM workflow_instance wi WHERE status = 'WAITING' AND next_run_at <= now() AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM campaign c WHERE c.campaign_id = wi.campaign_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ) ORDER BY next_run_at LIMIT 500 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) RETURNING *
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow_instance SET status = 'WAITING', current_step_id = #{nextStepId}, next_run_at = NULL, retry_count = 0, last_error = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE workflow_instance SET status = 'WAITING', current_step_id = #{nextStepId}, next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, retry_count = 0, last_error = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE workflow_instance SET status = 'COMPLETED', updated_at = now(), retry_count = 0, last_error = NULL WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE workflow_instance SET status = 'WAITING', retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, last_error = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = now() WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE workflow_instance SET status = 'FAILED', last_error = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = now() WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE workflow_instance SET status = 'WAITING', next_run_at = now() WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND updated_at < now() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'
UPDATE workflow_instance SET next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND status = 'WAITING' AND next_run_at IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM workflow_instance wi WHERE wi.campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM send_log s WHERE s.instance_id = wi.instance_id)
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow_instance SET status = 'CANCELLED', updated_at = now() WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND status IN ('WAITING', 'RUNNING')
UPDATE workflow_instance SET status = 'CANCELLED', updated_at = now() WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND status IN ('WAITING', 'RUNNING')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM workflow_instance ORDER BY instance_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow_instance (campaign_id, customer_id, current_step_id, status, next_run_at) SELECT #{campaignId}, c.customer_id, #{stepId}, 'WAITING', now() FROM customer c WHERE c.customer_id IN #{id} AND c.deleted_yn = 'N' ON CONFLICT (campaign_id, customer_id) DO NOTHING
